title: Isolated hypnotic regressions of the four Allagash witnesses
summary: Jim Weiner tells of Isolated hypnotic regressions of the four Allagash witnesses, about about a year of sessions after 1976 at Massachusetts, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: we all four of us agreed to undergo um

plain: Jim Weiner is one of four men who say they had a strange encounter together, known as the Allagash case. He says that after 1976, in Massachusetts, all four of them agreed to undergo hypnotic regression, which is hypnosis meant to bring back buried memories, in separate sessions over about a year. He links this to a researcher named Raymond Fowler and his book The Allagash Abductions, and it matters to the tellers because four separate accounts that matched would point to a shared experience.
